lines.text: The attendants propose gathering beautiful young women at Susa, and the one who pleases the king will replace Vashti.
Each young woman had twelve months of beauty treatments, then visited the king and returned in the morning to Hegai.

wrong_details.wrong: returned in the morning to Hegai
wrong_details.true: returned in the morning to Shaashgaz

lines.text: Mordecai learned that Bigthan and Teresh plotted against the king, and both were hanged after he told Esther.
